central_explanandum: How Korean writers realize meaning, stance, information structure, register and discourse continuity through alternative linguistic forms, rather than how an approval/governance system votes on revision proposals.

current_evidence.what_it_shows: Indexed addressing improves usable edit transport for this frozen model-plus-prompt setup
current_evidence.what_it_does_not_show: How Korean forms realize context, whether edits preserve meaning, or how discourse/stylistic constraints determine preferences

linguistic_axes.name: Information structure
linguistic_axes.contrast: preserve referent and proposition while varying focus/topic packaging
linguistic_axes.cautions: particle substitution may change presupposition, emphasis or argument structure

linguistic_axes.name: Sentence ending and stance
linguistic_axes.contrast: same propositional content under different speaker-audience and evidential conditions
linguistic_axes.cautions: relationship and situation are latent; do not infer from sentence alone

linguistic_axes.name: Discourse connection
linguistic_axes.contrast: similar local clauses with different discourse commitments

linguistic_axes.name: Lexical and syntactic realization
linguistic_axes.contrast: form alternatives conditioned on genre, rhythm and lexical conventionality
linguistic_axes.cautions: lexical synonymy does not guarantee identical information or naturalness

linguistic_axes.name: Preservation and plural solutions
linguistic_axes.contrast: identify legitimate alternative realizations rather than one teacher-corrected sentence
linguistic_axes.cautions: plurality is a linguistic observation, not agreement or preference optimization

design_rules.unit: Korean source + explicitly observed context + contrastive realizations; not proposer approval vote
minimum_three_way_record: explicit linguistic variable expected to change
controls: genre and speaker/listener context explicit or unknown
design_rules.negative_cases: Counterexamples, acceptability disagreements, and underdetermination retained; do not collapse into numeric scalar improvement.
design_rules.authority: Hypothesis taxonomy only; human linguistic judgements and population generalization not yet evidenced.

p53_disposition: Bounded indexed transport experiment complete as enabling evidence. No further candidate selection or fresh PIA solely to move 10/24 toward 18/24 without a named linguistic question and bounded value-of-information case.
next_decision: Open a prospective Korean realization contrast experiment first; pick one of L1-L4 under controlled context and construct minimal counterfactual sets with source rights and meaning-preservation adjudication. Governor only appears if it clarifies a language-theoretical underdetermination.
stop_rule: If more than one subsequent stage is spent on proposer competence, data escrow, reviewer agreement or candidate budget without a direct Korean expression/form/context finding, return to linguistic phenomenon and close tooling lane.
claims_not_granted: P53 protocol gain is a Korean writing theory success
P53 primary edit rate gives linguistic naturalness
stylistic choice can be reduced to consensus
